left_definition: highlight tonal regions share a warm color tendency across separate surfaces; shadow tonal regions share a cool tendency with controlled transitions through midtones
right_definition: highlight tonal regions share a cool color tendency across separate surfaces; shadow tonal regions share a warm tendency with controlled transitions through midtones

left_definition: An adult hourglass-family silhouette with visible upper-torso and hip expansion around a narrower natural waist, where the upper expansion is directionally more dominant than the lower expansion without becoming a waistless inverted triangle.
right_definition: An adult hourglass-family silhouette with visible upper-torso and hip expansion around a narrower natural waist, where the lower hip and upper-thigh expansion is directionally more dominant than the upper expansion without becoming a waistless triangle.

left_definition: a readable foreground plane carries relatively warm hues; a separate distant plane carries relatively cool hues with visible depth cues
right_definition: a readable foreground plane carries relatively cool hues; a separate distant plane carries relatively warm hues with visible depth cues

left_definition: A turned face presents one visibly broader cheek plane to the camera and that broader visible plane receives the dominant light, while the narrower far plane carries the primary shadow.
right_definition: A turned face presents one narrow far cheek plane to the camera and that narrow plane receives the dominant light, leaving the broader camera-facing cheek in modeled shadow.

left_definition: the dominant directional illumination has a visible color tint; the weaker fill contribution remains relatively neutral on its receiving regions
right_definition: the dominant directional illumination remains relatively neutral; the weaker fill contribution adds visible color to its receiving regions

left_definition: the subject contains more distinct principal hue families than the background; the background keeps fewer hue families even where its texture is detailed
right_definition: the background contains more distinct principal hue families than the subject; the subject keeps fewer hue families even where its texture is detailed
